submission_policy.staging: separate approved clean immutable source and fresh offline locked environment preflight; submit skips sync
submission_policy.scheduler_reconciliation: inspect both selected targets and known journal IDs before every submission; ambiguous or unregistered matching jobs block
submission_policy.submission_failure: record ambiguous; never resubmit automatically even if sbatch response is lost
submission_policy.cluster_fallback: none; any target/resource/source change requires a newly reviewed exact approval binding
submission_policy.dependency: afterany of registered same-slot predecessor on the same cluster; no arrays or races

stopping_rules: Stop each fit at its frozen stage boundary when any required coordinate competence gate fails.
Stop fixed-batch acquisition at update 100 on failure; no silent continuation or extension.
Stop on numerical errors; preserve failed output and scheduler status.
The hard allocation limit is 30 minutes per fit; retain timeout and partial status.
Submit each cell at most once; stop after 4 attempts whether successful, failed or ambiguous.
Do not select a final learning rate from this one-rate canary; this is 4 of 12 frozen discovery fits.
Qwen may propose follow-ups but cannot submit, execute proposals or accept scientific claims.
limitations: One seed and one learning rate; not a full-grid or confirmation result.
Architecture is confounded with requested cluster: GRU on Fir and LSTM on Nibi.
Full-budget training runtime, memory and disk footprint are not measured by tiny CPU fixtures.
Current target entitlement, typed GPU, clean source and offline cache must be verified before exact allocation approval.
